items.title: Open 32B w/ AutoMemory beats Opus: HOW? (Stanford)
items.summary:
AN open-source AI model, QWEN 32B, can achieve similar performance like Gemini 3 or Opus from Anthropic with an optimized memory management. New algorithms and insights from Stanford Univ. 

All rights w/ authors:
"AUTOMEM: Automated Learning of Memory as a Cognitive Skill"
by
Shengguang Wu Hao Zhu Yuhui Zhang Xiaohan Wang Serena Yeung-Levy
from 
Stanford University
arXiv:2607.01224
1 July, 2026
